preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of roads m is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities, each with a number between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of road descriptions matches the given number of roads m.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer.
The output is between 0 and n inclusive.
The output is the minimum number of separate cities after making the roads unidirectional.
